auth.loginSubtitle: Log in to keep your streak alive.
auth.forgotSubtitle: Enter your email and we'll send a link to set a new one.

account.title: Account
account.languageHint: The app's language. Food names stay as they were entered.
account.unitsHint: How weights and heights are shown. Your data is stored in metric either way.
account.fastingHint: Optional: set your daily eating window and the dashboard shows whether it's open. A window past midnight (e.g. 20:00 to 04:00) works too. Clear both fields to disable.
account.yourDataHint: Download everything you've logged. It's your data — take it anywhere.
account.deleteHint: Permanently removes your account and everything in it — profile, diary, weight history, favorites, recipes and foods you created. There is no undo.
